descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S24 「手机宽度和 WebKit 上的标签页、开关和扫描控件」 Tabs, toggles and the scan control at phone width and on WebKit

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 All Residents is the baseline list of everyone the physician follows at the facility, and every resident in it has a working 'In Today' / '+ Today' toggle.（UAT TC-09；TFA-92587 AC 1；TFA-92587 How it works 1）
  • U5 Marking 'In Today' puts the resident on the Today's Visits tab. Un-marking removes them from today without deleting them: they stay in All Residents.（UAT TC-09；TFA-92587 AC 2；TFA-92587 How it works 2；TFA-92587 How it works 6）

测试设计方法：设备（device） — 在手机尺寸或真机（iPhone / Pixel）上看布局和手势。

Given Visual-lane targets: Pixel 7 (Chromium) and iPhone 15 (WebKit)

When Open /snf, switch to All Residents, tap a toggle

Then Both tabs, each toggle and the scan control are visible and tappable without overlap. A long resident name does not push the toggle off-screen

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Visual-lane deterministic checks (tap-target size, overflow, overlap) on the All Residents screen; screenshot kept as evidence

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（automated）

S24 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-09.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：visual。
